title: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited (Merger of certain Co-operative Societies) Act, 1983.
full_text: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited (Merger of certain Co-operative Societies) Act, 1983. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198314 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 1983-09-24 Act Year: 1983 Short Title: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited (Merger of certain Co-operative Societies) Act, 1983. Long Title: An Act to provide for the merger of the Telangana State Wool Industrial Co-operative Society Limited, Hyderabad the Telangana State Textile Processing Co-operative Society Limited, Hyderabad and the Nellore District Weavers Service Co-operative Society Limited, Nellore with the Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited and for matters connected therewith or incidental. Department: Department of Industries and Commerce Enforcement Date: 22-07-1983 Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent, commencement and application. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Transfer of assets and liabilities of other societies to the Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited. Section 4. General effect of merger. Section 5. Ultimate authority to vest in the general body. Section 6. Management of affairs of transferee society. Section 7. Transfer of services of officers & other employees of the transferor societies. Section 8. Overriding effect of the Act. Section 9. Power to make rules. Section 10. Power to remove difficulties. Section 11. Amendment of Act 54 of 1976. Section 12. Repeal of Ordinance 14 of 1983.
